notes:
Church Recorder 0.3.0

- Organize imported streams under the exact country/state/province labels collected from Telegram.
- Filter by country/category and state/province alongside text search. State/province options follow the selected country, and Clear resets the search filters.
- Automatically assign time zones to matching streams using the Telegram labels and city-specific exceptions. Existing manual time zones are preserved, with a one-tap option to restore the automatic zone.
- Bundle IANA 2026f time-zone rules for the mapped zones, including recent Canadian changes, so older Android data does not give incorrect local clocks or service-time conversions.
- Support the Red Oak stream's space-containing alias during bookmark import.

The directory maps 244 Listen to Church aliases into 53 source groups, with 242 automatic geographic zones. Singing relays have no inferred location; streams missing from the source stay clearly unlabeled. No new streams are automatically added or selected for recording. Data applies to existing imports on update.

Use Settings → Check for updates now, or install this APK over the existing app. Android asks before installing. Full phone verification remains.
